context.analysis:
## Overview
A cross-border telehealth platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It ensures strict regional data residency, regulatory compliance, and high availability on unstable connections.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU / US) and Licensed Clinicians
- Local Pharmacies and Compliance Auditors / Officers
- Cross-Border Telehealth Platform (GCP hosted in `europe-west3` and `us-central1`)
- Third-Party Video Infrastructure (WebRTC SFU / Twilio / Agora)
- National e-Prescription Gateways (EU) and US Pharmacy Networks (NCPDP / HL7 FHIR)
- Third-Party AI LLM/ML Provider / Vertex AI
- Federated Identity Provider and Patient Consent Dashboard

## Relationships
- Patients & Clinicians -> Telehealth Platform via HTTPS, WSS, and TLS 1.3
- Telehealth Platform -> Third-Party Video SFU via WebRTC and DTLS
- Telehealth Platform -> External Pharmacy Gateways via REST/FHIR and mTLS
- Telehealth Platform -> AI Symptom Checker via gRPC and HTTPS
- Cross-Region Replication -> Cryptographically tokenized or blocked per R-04 consent

## Technology Stack
- GCP (`europe-west3` and `us-central1`): Regional VPC isolation for data residency (R-05)
- OAuth2/OIDC with FIDO2/WebAuthn MFA: Federated identity and consent token management (R-04)
- WebRTC / SFU: Adaptive bitrate video supporting connections below 300 kbit/s (R-06)
- HL7 FHIR & REST: US interoperability and national EU APIs (R-08)
- Cloud Logging & Cloud Storage: Immutable audit pipelines with Object Retention for EU MDR traceability (R-07)
- Cloud KMS & Cloud HSM: AES-256 encryption-at-rest with regional customer-managed keys

## Rationale
The architecture enforces strict regional isolation and zero-trust cross-border controls to satisfy GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR mandates. Cloud-native GCP services combined with adaptive WebRTC streaming ensure high availability, regulatory compliance, and reliable care even in rural areas with unstable internet.

containers.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency and regulatory compliance.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU/US) and Licensed Clinicians
- Regional API Gateway / BFF (Node.js/GraphQL)
- Consent & Policy Engine Container (.NET)
- Video Session Service (Go)
- AI Orchestration Service (Python/FastAPI)
- FHIR & Prescription Integration Service (.NET)
- GCP Regional Infrastructure (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`)

## Relationships
- Client Apps to Regional API Gateways via HTTPS / GraphQL
- API Gateways to Regional Services via gRPC over mTLS (Istio Service Mesh)
- AI Orchestration Service to Vertex AI via HTTPS / gRPC with VPC Service Controls
- Services to Regional WORM Storage via TLS 1.3 / Cloud KMS

## Technology Stack
- GCP GKE & Vertex AI: Scalable container orchestration and AI model hosting with regional isolation
- Istio Service Mesh: Enforces mTLS, circuit breaking, and service-to-service security
- .NET, Go, Node.js, Python: Microservice runtimes optimized for specific domain tasks
- Cloud KMS & Secret Manager: Regional key segregation and dynamic credential mounting

## Rationale
Independent regional GKE clusters and WORM storage guarantee GDPR and HIPAA compliance while maintaining data residency. gRPC over mTLS and Istio ensure low-latency, secure communication across distributed regional containers.

Regional API Gateway / BFF.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. The system enforces strict regional data residency and compliance using a cloud-native Google Cloud Platform architecture.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU/US), Licensed Clinicians, Local Pharmacies, Compliance Auditors
- Regional API Gateway / BFF (Node.js, GraphQL)
- Routing & Geo-Enforcement Middleware, GraphQL Resolvers, Audit & Telemetry Interceptor, Client Context & Policy Injector
- Consent & Policy Engine (.NET), Video Session Service (Go), AI Orchestration Service (Python, FastAPI), FHIR & Prescription Integration Service (.NET)
- GCP Cloud Storage (Regional WORM Storage), Cloud KMS, GCP Cloud Monitoring, Cloud CDN, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)

## Relationships
- Patients & Clinicians -> Regional API Gateway / BFF via HTTPS / GraphQL / WebSockets [TLS 1.3]
- Regional API Gateway / BFF -> Consent & Policy Engine, Video Session Service, AI Orchestration Service, FHIR & Prescription Integration Service via gRPC over mTLS [Istio Service Mesh]
- Audit Interceptor -> GCP Cloud Monitoring via OTLP / gRPC
- Cloud CDN -> Regional API Gateway / BFF for static assets only (no PHI/PII caching)

## Technology Stack
- Node.js & GraphQL: Chosen for backend-for-frontend flexibility and efficient data fetching for low-bandwidth rural clients.
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Enables horizontal pod autoscaling and multi-region deployment across `europe-west3` and `us-central1`.
- Istio Service Mesh: Provides mTLS, circuit breaking, and traffic splitting for secure microservices communication.
- gRPC: Ensures low-latency, high-performance internal communication between the BFF and backend microservices.

## Rationale
This architecture guarantees strict regulatory compliance by enforcing data residency per region using Istio service mesh and geo-enforcement middleware. It maintains high availability and low-bandwidth resilience for rural users through GraphQL BFF patterns, edge compression, and GKE autoscaling.

Consent & Policy Engine.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. The architecture enforces strict regional data residency and purpose-based consent while maintaining low-latency availability.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU/US), Licensed Clinicians, Compliance Auditors/Officers
- Regional API Gateway / BFF (Node.js, GraphQL)
- Consent & Policy Engine (.NET 8)
- Regional WORM Storage (GCP Cloud Storage, Cloud KMS)
- Regional Memorystore (Redis) with Pub/Sub Invalidation Bus
- GCP Memorystore (Redis) & GCP Pub/Sub DLQ

## Relationships
- Regional API Gateway / BFF -> Consent & Policy Engine: Verifies user consent and policies [gRPC, mTLS, Istio Service Mesh]
- Consent & Policy Engine -> Regional WORM Storage: Stores compliance and policy records securely [TLS 1.3, Cloud KMS]
- Consent & Policy Engine -> Regional Memorystore (Redis): Evaluates local policy caches and handles real-time Pub/Sub revocations [TCP, TLS]

## Technology Stack
- .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core: Powers the high-performance Consent & Policy Engine services
- gRPC: Enables ultra-low latency internal communication over Istio Service Mesh
- GCP Memorystore (Redis): Provides regional local-first caching and pub/sub invalidation bus
- OpenTelemetry: Streams compliance audit traces directly to GCP Cloud Logging

## Rationale
Local-first caching via Redis and cryptographic tokens ensure sub-millisecond policy evaluation and 99.999% availability, even during unstable internet connections or cross-region outages. Regional GKE deployments with strict cryptographic controls satisfy rigorous GDPR and HIPAA data residency requirements.

## Key Elements

* Consent & Policy Engine (.NET)
* Video Session Service (Go)
  * Session Coordinator Component (Go)
  * SFU Media Proxy Component (Go, Pion WebRTC)
  * Quality Telemetry Logger Component (Go)

* FHIR & Prescription Integration Service (.NET)
* Regional WORM Storage (GCP Cloud Storage, Cloud KMS)

* Session Coordinator -> SFU Media Proxy: Orchestrates media routing state [gRPC]
* SFU Media Proxy -> Third-Party Video Infrastructure: Relays encrypted streams [WebRTC, SRTP, DTLS]
* Quality Telemetry Logger -> Regional WORM Storage: Persists cryptographically signed audit logs [gRPC, TLS 1.3, Cloud KMS]

* Go (Pion WebRTC): Powers high-performance, low-latency video session handling and adaptive bitrate switching.
* Kubernetes (GKE): Manages containerized microservices with regional namespace isolation.
* gRPC & mTLS: Secures internal microservice communication and transport encryption.
* GCP Cloud KMS: Enforces regional customer-managed encryption keys for WORM storage.

## Rationale
[This decoupled, region-isolated architecture guarantees strict GDPR and HIPAA compliance while supporting adaptive video degradation for rural connectivity. Component-level separation of telemetry and media routing ensures absolute regulatory auditability without compromising real-time performance.]

AI Orchestration Service.analysis:
## Overview
The AI Orchestration Service securely processes patient symptom checker requests for a cross-border telehealth platform operating in the EU and US. It enforces regulatory compliance, regional data residency, and high availability while delivering traceable AI-driven care urgency recommendations.

## Key Elements
- **API Router & Validator:** FastAPI and Pydantic component validating payloads and enforcing JWT consent scopes.
- **Prompt & Context Assembler:** Prepares localized prompts and strips PII/PHI.
- **Inference Client:** Interacts with GCP Vertex AI via gRPC/mTLS.
- **Audit Logger:** Captures immutable inputs, model versions, and outputs.
- **Resilience Handler:** Implements circuit breaking and fallback urgency recommendations.
- **Regional WORM Storage:** GCP Cloud Storage secured via Cloud KMS and object retention policies.

## Relationships
- **Regional API Gateway / BFF -> API Router & Validator:** Forwards requests via gRPC, mTLS, and Istio Service Mesh.
- **Inference Client -> Vertex AI:** Executes remote model calls via gRPC/HTTPS within VPC Service Controls (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`).
- **Audit Logger -> Regional WORM Storage:** Asynchronously flushes immutable logs via HTTPS using Cloud KMS.

## Technology Stack
- **Python / FastAPI:** Chosen for asynchronous request handling and fast ML ecosystem integration.
- **GCP Cloud Run:** Deployed with `min-instances > 0` to eliminate cold starts.
- **GCP Vertex AI:** Managed machine learning backend for symptom inference.
- **GCP Secret Manager:** Dynamic retrieval of credentials and keys without hardcoding.
- **OpenTelemetry:** Distributed tracing across the Istio service mesh and FastAPI.

## Rationale
This architecture ensures strict GDPR and HIPAA compliance by isolating regional data processing and stripping patient identifiers before third-party AI invocation. The inclusion of automated fallback mechanisms, bounded async logging, and immutable WORM storage satisfies medical device accountability rules while guaranteeing high availability in low-bandwidth conditions.

parentContainer:

FHIR & Prescription Integration Service.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. It ensures strict regional data residency and regulatory compliance across both jurisdictions.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU / US), Licensed Clinicians, Local Pharmacies, Compliance Auditors
- Regional API Gateway / BFF (Node.js, GraphQL)
- FHIR & Prescription Integration Service (.NET Core)
- Prescription Orchestrator, FHIR Adapter, EU Gateway Adapter, Validation & Mapping Validator
- Regional WORM Storage (GCP Cloud Storage, Cloud KMS)
- National e-Prescription Gateways and US Pharmacy Networks

## Relationships
- Regional API Gateway -> FHIR & Prescription Integration Service [gRPC, mTLS, Istio Service Mesh]
- FHIR & Prescription Integration Service -> National Gateways / Pharmacy Networks [REST/FHIR, SOAP, mTLS]
- FHIR & Prescription Integration Service -> Regional WORM Storage [TLS 1.3, Cloud KMS]
- Prescription Orchestrator -> MassTransit & Notification Event Consumer [In-Process Bus]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud utilizing `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for regional data residency.
- .NET Core & C#: Powers the FHIR & Prescription Integration Service with high performance.
- MassTransit & Transactional Outbox: Ensures zero message loss when communicating with unstable pharmacy networks.
- GCP Cloud KMS & HSM: Handles field-level encryption, audit logging checksums, and cryptographic payload signing for legal non-repudiation.
- Istio Service Mesh & Polly: Provides mTLS, gRPC rate limiting, and circuit breakers for resilience against gateway failures.

## Rationale
This architecture enforces strict regional data residency and HIPAA/GDPR compliance by isolating data processing to dedicated GCP regions. Asynchronous messaging and transactional outboxes guarantee reliable cross-border e-prescription delivery despite unstable network connections.

Regional WORM Storage.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It utilizes Regional WORM Storage to ensure strict compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR traceability mandates.

## Key Elements
- **Regional WORM Storage Components**: Retention Policy Manager (Go), Audit Query API (Go, gRPC), Encryption & Key Manager (GCP Cloud KMS), Audit Export Bundle Generator (Go)
- **Infrastructure**: GCP Cloud Storage (europe-west3, us-central1) with Bucket Lock in compliance mode
- **Users & Services**: Compliance Auditors / Officers, Consent & Policy Engine, Video Session Service, AI Orchestration Service, FHIR & Prescription Integration Service

## Relationships
- **Consent & Policy Engine -> Regional WORM Storage**: Stores compliance records securely [TLS 1.3, Cloud KMS]
- **Video Session Service -> Regional WORM Storage**: Stores session logs securely [TLS 1.3, Cloud KMS]
- **AI Orchestration Service -> Regional WORM Storage**: Stores audit logs securely [TLS 1.3, Cloud KMS]
- **FHIR & Prescription Integration Service -> Regional WORM Storage**: Stores prescription data securely [TLS 1.3, Cloud KMS]
- **Compliance Auditors -> Audit Query API**: Queries immutable logs [gRPC over TLS 1.3, mTLS with ABAC]
- **Compliance Auditors -> Audit Export Bundle Generator**: Requests regulatory packages [gRPC over TLS 1.3]
- **Retention Policy Manager -> GCP Cloud Storage**: Applies immutable lock and storage tiering [Cloud Storage API]

## Technology Stack
- **GCP Cloud Storage**: Provides WORM storage with Bucket Lock in compliance mode for immutable data archiving.
- **GCP Cloud KMS**: Manages regionally isolated customer-managed encryption keys for data residency.
- **Go**: Implements microservices for high-performance retention policies, queries, and bundle generation.
- **gRPC / TLS 1.3**: Secures internal and external API communications.

## Rationale
This architecture guarantees strict regional data residency by isolating EU and US storage buckets and keys. Compliance requirements are met via immutable WORM storage, automated tiering, and cryptographic audit export verification.
